categories.main_business_segments: China Yangtze Power Co., Ltd. primarily operates in large-scale hydropower generation, managing six major cascade hydropower stations including Three Gorges, Xiluodu, Xiangjiaba, Wudongde, Baihetan, and Gezhouba. The company also actively develops pumped storage projects, renewable energy bases integrating hydropower, wind, solar, and energy storage, and engages in smart integrated energy services. Additionally, it has international operations including overseas hydropower and renewable energy projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced hydropower technologies with a focus on high-efficiency water resource utilization and cascade reservoir joint dispatch. It employs digital transformation and intelligent operation and maintenance systems, including industrial AI solutions for hydropower. The company also invests in hydrogen fuel cell technology for clean energy applications and integrates multi-energy complementary systems combining water, wind, solar, and storage.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are large state-owned power grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, serving major economic regions including the Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta. The company also serves international markets through its overseas subsidiaries and projects, including Peru and Pakistan. Its end markets focus on electricity supply for industrial, commercial, and residential users emphasizing clean and renewable energy consumption.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with hydropower stations located along the Yangtze River basin in provinces such as Sichuan, Yunnan, Hubei, and Chongqing. It has expanded internationally with investments and operations in Peru, Pakistan, and other countries. The company’s headquarters is in Beijing, with subsidiaries and projects distributed domestically and overseas.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Yangtze Power operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electricity supply chain as a power generation company. It also extends into downstream activities through power sales and integrated energy services, and upstream through investments in renewable energy projects and technology development. The company manages the entire hydropower production process from resource management to electricity dispatch and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes consolidating its hydropower base, expanding into new energy sectors such as pumped storage and integrated renewable energy bases, and advancing smart energy technologies. It emphasizes high-level technological innovation with significant R&D investment, focusing on digital transformation, AI-driven operation, and hydrogen energy applications. The company also prioritizes international expansion and sustainable development aligned with national carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electricity produced by its hydropower stations and renewable energy projects. Additional income streams include investment returns from equity holdings, power sales services, and government subsidies. The company also earns revenue from market-based electricity trading and green certificate transactions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China Yangtze Power is the largest listed hydropower company in China and holds a leading position domestically and globally in hydropower generation capacity. Its main competitors include other large state-owned power generation enterprises and renewable energy companies in China. The company leverages its scale, technological capabilities, and integrated energy solutions to maintain a competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 78.1 billion, a 13.43% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 27.24 billion, up 14.81%. Total assets were about RMB 572 billion with a slight decrease from the previous year. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profit, and cash flow, supported by strategic acquisitions and investments in new energy projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Yangtze Power emphasizes its role as a provider of clean, reliable, and efficient hydropower energy, contributing significantly to carbon reduction and energy security. Its unique value lies in its large-scale cascade hydropower system, advanced water resource management, and integration of multi-energy complementary systems. The company differentiates itself through technological innovation, digital transformation, and commitment to sustainable development and social responsibility.
